edges.reason: msg.sender flows into transfer as the implicit _from argument.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer._to is passed as transferFrom._to.
transfer._value is passed as transferFrom._value.
msg.sender is used in transferFrom for the allowance check and allowance debit.
msg.sender indexes allowance in approve.
msg.sender must equal owner before the arbitrary delegatecall is executed.
msg.sender must equal owner in init.
msg.sender must equal owner in batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner in setTradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes owner and initial balance holder in the constructor.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value).
transferFrom._from is forwarded to ensure._from.
transferFrom._to is forwarded to ensure._to.
transferFrom._value is forwarded to ensure._value.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the caller is not exempt.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
ensure._from is passed to condition._from.
ensure._value is passed to condition._value.
pairFor result is stored in the local _UNI inside ensure.
ensure reads the canSale whitelist mapping.
ensure reads the owner state variable.
ensure reads tradeAddress.
ensure reads the constant UNI address.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from].
condition reads _saleNum.
condition reads _minSale.
condition reads _maxSale.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom debits and credits balanceOf without checked safe math.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve._spender is used as the allowance key.
approve._value is stored into the allowance mapping.
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
delegate.a is the target of the delegatecall.
delegate.b is the calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
The delegatecall executes untrusted code in this contract's context, potentially re-entering balance-changing functions.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
init scales values by decimals.
init.token is scaled and assigned to _minSale.
init.maxToken is scaled and assigned to _maxSale.
init.saleNum is assigned to _saleNum.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length with no overflow protection.
batchSend._value is a multiplicand in the unchecked total computation.
batchSend._tos.length is a multiplicand in the unchecked total computation.
The overflowed total is subtracted from the caller balance.
batchSend._value indirectly drives the unchecked balance subtraction.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
The unchecked local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
The batchSend loop is governed by index i.
batchSend._to is read from the _tos array inside the loop.
balanceOf[_to] is credited inside the unchecked loop.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value with only a prior require.
transferFrom._value is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress.addr is stored into tradeAddress.
pairFor computes and returns the local pair value.
pairFor.factory is consumed by the pairFor hash.
pairFor.tokenA is consumed by the pairFor hash.
pairFor.tokenB is consumed by the pairFor hash.
tokenA may be assigned to local token0 after sorting.
tokenB may be assigned to local token1 after sorting.
Constructor writes name.
Constructor writes symbol.
Constructor writes totalSupply.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor mints the supply to msg.sender in balanceOf.
Constructor grants an infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Constructor scales the supply by decimals.
constructor._name is stored into name.
constructor._symbol is stored into symbol.
constructor._supply is scaled and stored into totalSupply.
